accountingLimitations: Owned Sessions counted once; inherited context provenance does not itself incur an extra usage entry. Each worker latest cumulative snapshot is checked rather than adding every followup snapshot.

Successful compaction usage is included in Session totals; failed, cancelled or retried summary attempt usage can be dropped. Timing does not contain usage or request purpose. Any summary evidence conservatively prevents asserting complete totals; known summary usage is not removed or estimated.
Successful SDK reconciliation cannot recover missing provider usage. Aborted/error messages with zero or missing usage keep completeness false; partial output is represented only by character counts.
Model-request durations are Pi stream-function spans, including transport/provider waiting, not pure inference or every hidden HTTP retry. Request IDs deduplicate cumulative telemetry snapshots.
Lock waits and tool/model durations overlap across agents. Sums are resource occupancy observations, not additive wall-clock or proof of critical-path improvement.
Host completion and wrapper end-to-end timestamps are separate, and may differ due to orchestration/cleanup. Worker completed means the turn ended, not acceptance or useful delivery.
Tool transport results are separated from game domain success/error; bash semantic success and actual worker code delivery require the separate delivery review.
No raw model text, tool arguments, outputs, candidate patches, hidden evaluator contents, or credentials are written. Only metadata, numeric projections and source hashes are emitted.
This gate relies on preserved Host completion evidence; it is not a fresh OS process census. Missing or changing records fail closed.
Single SDK reports zero usage for a 36.814-second provider-error response containing 459 thinking characters. The exact unreported or billable amount cannot be recovered and is not estimated.
No compaction evidence was found; the conservative compaction unknown policy was not the cause of this batch completeness flag. Do not claim confirmed compaction fee omission.
Multi completeUsageObserved means all observed persisted usage is valid/reconciled, not a provider invoice or proof about hidden transport retries.
Root/worker budgets are confirmed by saved V5 receipts and frozen implementation. Runs ended below limits, so this audit does not retest enforcement at exhaustion.

Single charged executions are reconstructed from telemetry because its outer preview has no supervisor counter; Multi reconstructed664 matches the supervisor receipt. game_stop is cleanup-exempt; capture_candidate is an internal measured lock operation without an additional budget admission.
Worker 45-minute/512-call caps are turn caps. Three followup_task calls delivered during existing worker turns do not create three additional turns.
No claim about acceptance or worker edits is made here. The Root coding-call count changes220→218, while Root reported tokens increase10.5%; this alone is not a causal delivery assessment.
